changes.title: Visage Card Checker & Stat Verification
changes.description: Evaluate and compare your Visage Cards with refined percentage calculations, roll analysis, and stat benchmarks to fine-tune your loadouts.

changes.title: Targeted Monster Hunts & In-Game Roster View
changes.description: Quickly identify which monsters to hunt to upgrade your Visage collection. Includes an in-game roster layout and search that scans through all card skills.

changes.title: Monster Study Tracker, Hitboxes & Stats
changes.description: Track your Monster Study completion directly in the Field Guide, with detailed hitboxes, element effectiveness, and monster combat stats.

changes.title: Target Visage Cards on Monsters
changes.description: See the exact Visage cards you are hunting for directly on each monster's profile to streamline your hunt planning.

changes.title: Build Planner: Export to Image
changes.description: Generate clean, high-resolution graphic cards of your custom builds, complete with equipped armour, weapon stats, and active visage synergy to share with other hunters.

changes.title: In-App Feedback & Bug Resolution Messages
changes.description: Receive direct in-app messages and status updates from the team when your bug report or feedback is resolved. Check the new My Reports tab to see replies.

releases.title: Visage Collection: Weekly Reset & Hunt Planner Updates
releases.description: Visage Collection: Weekly Reset & Hunt Planner Updates

changes.title: New "By Monster" Progression View
changes.description: Added a dedicated By Monster view to the Visage Collection, laying out all monsters (Large Monsters in game order, Small Monsters alphabetically) with both of their potential Ink types displayed in a single column.

changes.title: Instant Card Tracking
changes.description: Mark cards as owned, update rarity tiers (Fine, Rare, Epic, Superior), and adjust quantities directly on each monster's card without switching screens.

changes.title: Targeted Rarity Hunting Filters
changes.description: Filter by rarity goal (Fine, Rare, Epic, or Superior). Selecting a target immediately filters out any monster where you already have a card at that tier or higher, highlighting only the monsters you still need to hunt before the reset.

changes.title: Direct Field Guide Links
changes.description: Clicking any monster's icon instantly opens their details and drop tables in the Monster Field Guide.

changes.title: Polished In-Game UI Locks
changes.description: Replaced placeholder lock emojis with the official in-game lock icon (/img/ui/lock.png) across cards, loadout strips, and builds to clearly signal missing cards.
